Public Supplier List

The list of supplier facilities includes original design manufacturers (ODMs), final assembly and                                   material suppliers that Dell buys from directly and/or
provide substantial product transformation. The volume and nature of business conducted with suppliers shifts as business nee                                                          ds change. This
list represents a snapshot covering at least 95% of Dell’s spend during fiscal                             year 2025.
